  "title": "Cookie consent",
  "body": "## Description of problem\r\nCookie consent has become a standard in many parts of the world. Althought 3rd party solutions exist, it behooves us that DNN has support for this out of the box. It would also allow us to centralize the options for this in the admin UI.\r\n\r\n## Description of solution\r\nI propose to use [cookie consent from insites](https://cookieconsent.insites.com) which is quite popular and well featured.\r\n\r\nThere are 3 sets of settings that can come from separate places:\r\n\r\n1. Configurable by admin: Learn More Link.\r\n2. Texts that can come from resource files: Message, Dismiss Text, Deny Text, Link text\r\n3. Layout/UI related settings. These can be taken as default but overridden by a skin designer in their skin.\r\n\r\n## Additional context\r\nThe proposed solution uses a js file of 21 Kb and a css file of 4Kb. If not activated these would not be loaded and DNN behavior is identical to what it is now.\r\n\r\nA skin designer can create an object in window scope called \"cookieconsentoptions\" and if present our code will pick it up and merge it with the admin settings and initialize the component with that. If not the default settings for the consent popup would be used. This solution allows for the maximum freedom of skin designers.\r\n\r\nNote that this does not impede users from using a 3rd party solution.\r\n",
